EVENTS.CLERGY_GENERIC_ACCEPT: I will comply with your request.
EVENTS.CLERGY_GENERIC_REFUSE: There are other priorities at the moment.
EVENTS.WINEKING_DESC: The Bishop's steward demands a month at your monastery! The Bishop commissioned him to judge if your vineyard is worthy of a seal of prestige. Such privilege would make your wine extremely valuable!
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_YES: A month as our guest is certainly going to convince him.
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_YES2: Common friends could enlighten his judgement!
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_YES3: How much could this seal be worth?!
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_LATER: Ask him to come back later.
EVENTS.WINEKING_QUEST_FAIL_DESC: The steward was not impressed by your land! Before leaving, he said he would have you judged for the mistreatment of grapes if he could.
EVENTS.WINEKING_QUEST_FAIL2_DESC: The steward decided that your land was not worthy of the seal. However, he promised to return as you certainly deserve another chance.
EVENTS.WINEKING_QUEST_SUCCESS_DESC: The steward was happy with their visit and awarded you a seal of prestige, ensuring your wine would be recognized far and wide.
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_YES2_DESC: The steward gave a verdict that may not entirely be his own: Your wine deserves the "hard-earned" seal of prestige!
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_YES3_DESC: Satisfied with the weight of the coin purse you threw his way, the steward announced his verdict: Your wine deserves the "hard-earned" seal of prestige!
EVENTS.WINEKING_QUEST_DESC: I have invited the Bishop's Steward to spend a month at our monastery to examine our vineyard.
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_YES_TOOLTIP: The Bishop's steward will examine your vineyards and winemaking process, expecting the best the Realm has to offer.
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_YES2_TOOLTIP: As a well-respected village of the Clergy, you have "common friends" with the Bishop that could let you skip the examination.
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_YES3_TOOLTIP: The steward's wage is most likely that of a servant, which your coins could address in exchange for the seal.
EVENTS.WINEKING_CHOICE_LATER_TOOLTIP: The Bishop's steward will return later with the same offer.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_MYDDLE_1_DESC: Trade with Myddle is booming! They plan on investing this wealth into restoring their old church, which would attract pilgrims. This could also benefit your village if you supply them with resources.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_MYDDLE_2_DESC: Thanks to your business, Myddle is getting quite the notoriety! They offered to increase the trading capacity with your village if you were to help them restore another church.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_MYDDLE_3_DESC: Myddle aims to restore their ancient cathedral! It is an ambitious plan, but if you were to participate in its construction, the wealth it would provide could greatly benefit your trading.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_MYDDLE_R_DESC: Myddle's Trading volume is ever-increasing! Thanks to the goods supplied by your village, they plan to build even more churches for pilgrims to visit. Will you help by sending them Polished Stones?
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_MYDDLE_QUEST_SUCCESS_DESC: The folks at Myddle are grateful for the stones! They will enjoy plenty more pilgrims while you enjoy fairer trade.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_DAVENPORT_1_DESC: Davenport is praising your mutual business! They are planning to build a bridge to help increase the volume of merchandise moving into their village, and they hope you will contribute.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_DAVENPORT_2_DESC: To handle all the goods being traded, Davenport is considering adding ferries by their waterfront. They hope you will contribute.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_DAVENPORT_3_DESC: Davenport is planning a new bridge to handle the merchandise going to and from your village and would love your contribution.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_DAVENPORT_R_DESC: Davenport is adding more ferries to their waterfront to better manage your mutually flourishing trade. They hope you can help by supplying resources.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_DAVENPORT_QUEST_SUCCESS_DESC: Davenport is grateful for the planks and assures that your village's goods will soon flow directly into their markets!
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_TROTBURY_1_DESC: Trotbury sees potential in a fleet of carriages! They want to trade more goods with your village and would like your help crafting such vehicles by supplying them with tools.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_TROTBURY_2_DESC: Trade is going well, and Trotbury now prospers as much as you do! They plan to handle additional resources with a new fleet of carriages and would like your contribution.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_TROTBURY_3_DESC: Trotbury is becoming wealthier by the minute and now has an ever-growing volume of goods for trade! They are ready to craft more carriages to ease transportation and wonder if you wish to contribute.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_TROTBURY_R_DESC: Business with Trotbury is going well! They are ready to craft new carriages to move your merchandise and ask for a contribution of tools.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_TROTBURY_QUEST_SUCCESS_DESC: Your tools are on their way to Trotbury! The craftsmen there assure you they will use them effectively, and they hope you both find this new plan mutually beneficial.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_KINSTONE ABBEY_1_DESC: The Abbey of Kinstone seeks a patron to endow new trading counters and improve business relations. They hope you will provide such influence.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_KINSTONE ABBEY_2_DESC: Trading has flourished at the Abbey, welcoming many new novices to work the fields. With these new resources, they seek your patronage to expand their trading counters further.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_KINSTONE ABBEY_3_DESC: Thanks to your support, the Abbey of Kinstone has become a beacon of prosperity for the faithful across the realm. They wish to expand even further with your continued backing.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_KINSTONE ABBEY_R_DESC: The Abbey of Kinstone appreciates your support! They are now looking to open a new trade counter and seek your patronage to expand their monastery once more.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_KINSTONE ABBEY_QUEST: Charcoal delivery to the Abbey of Kinstone
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_KINSTONE ABBEY_QUEST_DESC: I have promised to provide charcoal to the Abbey of Kinstone.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_MYDDLE_QUEST: Delivery of Polished Stones to Myddle
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_COMMONERPROMOTION_DES: Your hard-working Serfs believe they are due for a promotion! Once all their needs have been fully fulfilled, a villager can rise to a higher status. Commoners and Citizens provide for the village in new ways but have additional needs.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_COMMONERPROMOTION_QUE: I have agreed to learn how to promote a few Serfs to Commoners.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_BAILIFFMANDATES_DESC: Villagers believe we are prosperous enough to be supported by a Bailiff! This nominated person will handle critical tasks such as prospecting nearby deposits and petitioning the Estates on your behalf.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_BAILIFFMANDATES_QUEST: I have decided to learn how to nominate a Bailiff.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_NEWTAX_DESC: Some villagers think our treasury would benefit from new means of taxation! However, they remind you that taxing services will not make you very popular with the labourers...
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_NEWTAX_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to learn how to add a new tax.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_ESTATESPECIALIZATION_:
Your village has caught the interest of the Estates of the Realm! They anticipate splendid monuments, which will undoubtedly define the future of your people.

Who will you oblige first: the Kingdom, the Clergy, or the Labourers?
Your village has caught the interest of the Estates of the Realm! They anticipate splendid monuments, which will undoubtedly define the future of your people.
Our Monasteries will be the pride of the Clergy!
Our Manor Houses will serve the Labourers!
Our Castles will be vanguards of the Kingdom!
I have promised to build a splendid Monastery to progress with the Clergy Estate.
I have promised to build a splendid Castle to progress with the Kingdom Estate.
I have promised to build a splendid Manor House to progress with the Labour Estate.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CLERGYINFLUENCE_DESC: The work your folk put into the church is paying off!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CLERGYINFLUENCE_ACCUM: The work your folk put into the church is paying off! A renowned priest from Northbury heard of your newly founded monument and would like to perform masses in your village. Being fair to such people would definitely improve your standing amongst the Clergy!
Let us provide for your needs!
Let us pay you for your help!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CLERGYINFLUENCE_SPEND: While the neighbouring priest was walking around the village, you overheard him talking about a devout merchant from Northbury who offers lower prices to faithful individuals like you and your folks. Building a good relationship with the clergy could help you avail of those lower prices!
The merchant should help faithfuls like us!
Nothing a few coins can't buy.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CLERGYINFLUENCE_ACCUM: The renowned priest had a pleasant time in your village and promises to spread the word of your piety.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CLERGYINFLUENCE_SPEND: The pious merchant has been convinced to deliver you products at fairer prices, at least for a while.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CLERGYINFLUENCE_QUEST: I promised the priest from Northbury that I would provide him with food during his stay in the village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_FIRSTEDICT_DESC:
Villagers believe we have achieved enough prosperity to implement our very first Edict! These are laws and policies that help you shape the village in new ways. Additionally, you can enable Privileges, which are benefits granted by each of the Estates.

Once Edicts and Privileges are enacted, they must be revised with a mandate to be removed.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_FIRSTEDICT_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to learn how Edicts work by enacting one in an unlocked slot.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_FIRSTPRIVILEGE_DESC:
Our standing with the Estates of the Realm has allowed us to enact our first Privilege! These are benefits granted by each of the Estates. You can also enable Edicts, which are laws and policies that help you shape the village in new ways.

Once enacted, Edicts and Privileges must be revised with a mandate to be removed.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_FIRSTPRIVILEGE_QUEST_: I have agreed to learn how Privileges work by enacting one in an unlocked slot.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VISITHOSPITIUM_DESC: The Bishop's steward has heard of your interest in building a Hospitium! Such a building will attract visitors of all kinds into your village, who might donate resources if their stay is pleasant. The steward will do you the honour of being the first to visit if you so wish.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VISITHOSPITIUM_CHOICE: Let's build a Hospitium and host the steward.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VISITHOSPITIUM_BUILD_: You built the Hospitium for the enjoyment of all visitors! As promised, the Bishop's steward will visit your village soon.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VISITHOSPITIUM_VISIT_: The Bishop's steward rested at your village and now has to leave. He wishes to give a small donation as thanks for the stay.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VISITHOSPITIUM_BUILD_: I have agreed to learn the basics of hosting Visitors by building a Hospitium.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VISITHOSPITIUM_VISIT_: I have agreed to learn the basics of hosting visitors by welcoming the Bishop's steward for a few days.
Host the Bishop's steward with 60% approval.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CLERGYINFLUENCE_ACCUM: Supply the priest and improve your standing with the Clergy.
Pay the priest and improve your standing with the Clergy.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CLERGYINFLUENCE_SPEND: Influence the merchant to help your village.
Hire the merchant to help your village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_ESTATESPECIALIZATION_: Earn the blessing of the Clergy by building a magnificent Monastery.
Earn the approval of the Labourers by building an impressive Manor House.
Earn the favour of the King by building an imposing Castle.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VISITHOSPITIUM_CHOICE: The Bishop's steward will visit the village once he knows a Hospitium has been built.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_BAILIFFMANDATES_COMPL: You nominated a Bailiff to help your village! Each mandate has a specific purpose. Use them wisely!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_COMMONERPROMOTION_COM: You promoted your first villager! Commoners will pay more taxes but have additional needs, as do Citizens.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_FIRSTEDICT_COMPLETION: You enacted your first Edict! Once set, Edicts and Privileges can only be revised using the corresponding Estate's mandate.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_FIRSTPRIVILEGE_COMPLE: You enacted your first Privilege! Once set, Edicts and Privileges can only be revised using the corresponding Estate's mandate.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_ESTATESPECIALIZATION_: You progressed with an Estate! Earning further Splendour and Prosperity will allow you to unlock and construct additional buildings.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_NEWTAX_COMPLETION_DES: You enacted a new Tax for your village! While Labourers don't like being taxed too much, it will certainly support your treasury.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGMONASTERY_DES: Hearing about your interest in building a Monastery, some of the most faithful among your villagers would like to guide you through the first steps of its construction. Who will the Monastery be accepting?
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGMONASTERY_CHO: Our Monastery will accept both Monks and Nuns.
Build a Monastery for men and women alike.
Construct a monastery for men. You can include women later via a dormitory for Nuns.
Construct a monastery for women. You can include men later via a dormitory for Monks.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGMONASTERY_QUE: I have agreed to construct some of the most important buildings a Monastery should have.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGMONASTERY_COM: You built a Monastery! Herbs can fetch a fair price at the market, while Manuscripts are important for promoting Novices.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_MONASTERYPROMOTION_DE: Your Monastery is doing quite well! Some Novices devoted to the Faith think it's time for promotions. Such recognition would allow them to take on advanced roles such as Refectory Head, Cooks, or Bee Keepers.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_MONASTERYPROMOTION_CH: Spend Manuscripts to promote a female Novice into a Nun. You can promote more Novices afterwards.
Spend Manuscripts to promote a male Novice into a Monk. You can promote more Novices afterwards.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_MONASTERYPROMOTION_QU: I have agreed to spend Manuscripts to promote a Novice.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_MONASTERYPROMOTION_CO: Your Novice has been promoted! Monks and Nuns can perform additional tasks but must spend time meditating in Cloisters.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_KINGDOMINFLUENCE_ACCU:
The King wants to see how his vassals' armies are fairing and has sent delegates across the Realm to test their might. This challenge will require some of your soldiers to be active in the field for a few days.

Proving yourself to this delegate would certainly improve your standing amongst the Kingdom!
The delegate will expect you to fulfil a military mission.
My best guardsman could prove it right here, right now!
Your best guardsman will attempt to impress the delegate.
My combatants are too busy right now.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_KINGDOMINFLUENCE_SPEN: The delegate declares that a purse of coins shall be gifted to every vassal who demonstrates the valour and might of their army, just like you did. A small token of gratitude, for the true gift is to serve your humble King!
It is an honour, as always.
I'd rather have a chest of coins...
The delegate does not expect to haggle—especially not for a gift—but you can still attempt to do so.
A humble King is all I need.
EVENTS.MTC_ADVANCEDONBOARDING_KINGDOMINFLUENCE_: The King wants to test your combatants with a few challenges to determine if you are a worthy vassal. It should not be too dangerous...
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_KINGDOMINFLUENCE_ACCU: Your combatants demonstrated true loyalty towards the King, and his delegate promised to report such a feat.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_KINGDOMINFLUENCE_SPEN: You were gifted some coins for your loyalty to the King.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_DESC: You learn Davenport is imposing a new taxation law on traded goods. The details are a mystery, but you know it yields considerable profits without impacting commerce. If you were to crack its secret, such a tax could greatly benefit your village!
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_YES: We will figure it out as we trade.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_YES3: One of the Elders will tell us!
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_FAIL2_DESC: Your Bailiff learned everything about Davenport's new taxation system. However, the city officials learned of your scheme!
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_QUEST_SUCCESS_DESC: After calculating and accounting for countless deals, you finally understand Davenport's mystery tax!
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_YES2_DESC: Your Bailiff figured out Davenport's new taxation system and did it without being noticed.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_YES3_DESC: Being in the good graces of one of the Elders, you have been given a copy of Davenport's trading law.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_QUEST_DESC: I have decided to figure out Davenport's mystery law by trading with its merchants.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_YES_TOOLTIP: By sufficiently trading with Davenport, you can deduce how their new taxation works so you can reproduce it for your own village.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_YES2_TOOLTIP: Let your Bailiff figure out the taxation by spying on Davenport's official documents.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_YES2_TOOLTIP_SUCCES: Davenport is unaware of the scheme.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_YES3_TOOLTIP: Gold and influence will allow one of the Elders to share their connections and knowledge regarding Davenport's business.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_CHOICE_LATER_TOOLTIP: Davenport's taxation will stay a mystery. For now.
EVENTS.TRADETAXATION_FAILURE_TOOLTIP: Davenport does not appreciate being spied upon and severed our trading partnership.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WHEAT_CLERGY_DESC: The Bishop seeks to purchase large shipments of wheat because the monks at a nearby monastery are short on food. One of his merchants noticed your farm and wants to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WHEAT_KINGDOM_DESC: The King needs additional wheat to feed his soldiers and will pay all vassals capable of providing. As it happens, one of his merchants noticed your farm and wants to extend an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_KINGDOM_DESC: The King is arming a new battalion and will pay his vassals for iron ore. One of his merchants has seen your quarry and wants to propose a deal.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_CLERGY_DESC: The Bishop is planning to increase this season's wine sales but is in dire need of iron ore for the barrel bands. One of his merchants has seen your quarry and wants to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_LABOUR_DESC: The Elders are looking for iron ore as a nearby village is dramatically running low on tools. One of their merchants has seen your quarry and wishes to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOL_LABOUR_DESC: The Elders are looking to increase a nearby settlement's clothing stockpile. One of their merchants has seen your flock of sheep and wants to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOL_KINGDOM_DESC: The King has commissioned woollen flags to be proudly displayed on his fortresses. A merchant aware of this project noticed your flock of sheep and wants to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOL_CLERGY_DESC: The Bishop has sought to purchase wool ever since some monks were too strict on their vows to the point of becoming threadbare. Having spotted your flock of sheep, one of his merchants wishes to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOD_KINGDOM_DESC: The King is planning new outposts around the borders. One of his merchants noticed your woodcutter camps and wants to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOD_CLERGY_DESC: The Bishop is looking to build a few chapels along the pilgrimage routes. One of his merchants noticed your woodcutter camps and wants to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WHEAT_CLERGY_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wheat to the Bishop.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WHEAT_KINGDOM_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wheat to the King.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_KINGDOM_QUEST: Selling Iron Ore to the King
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_KINGDOM_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of iron ore to the King.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_CLERGY_QUEST: Selling Iron Ore to the Bishop
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_CLERGY_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of iron ore to the Bishop.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_LABOUR_QUEST: Selling Iron Ore to the Elders
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_ORE_LABOUR_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of iron ore to the Elders.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOL_LABOUR_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wool to the Elders.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOL_CLERGY_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wool to the Bishop.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOL_KINGDOM_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wool to the King.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOD_CLERGY_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wood to the Bishop.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOD_KINGDOM_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wood to the King.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTMONASTERY_DESC: An aura of serenity settles in as your first villagers recite their religious vow and convert to a life of ascetic piety. Your people have been blessed with a monastery: may it bring faith and wealth!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTTAVERN_DESC: Revellers are rejoicing over your village's very first tavern! Fine drinks and warm meals are expected, along with plenty of celebrations. There will be good times ahead!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTKEEP_DESC: Forward, march! The clamour of military exercises echoes throughout the village. These might not be the most pleasant sounds, but they are a good reminder that your people are safe!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_MILITARYVICTORY_DESC: Your victorious Company brought home tales of their adventures abroad, such as how one person defeated a hulking enemy, how others withstood a terrible storm in the dead of night, and how that one won the roast-eating contest. All tales to truly delight your people!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTBEER_DESC: The village is abuzz as the first batch of beer is ready to be enjoyed! Mugs are raised high, and the villagers eagerly anticipate the good times ahead in their beloved tavern.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTCITIZEN_DESC: The village celebrates its very first Citizen! From humble beginnings, this villager was given a new role - with new privileges - filling everyone with pride and hope for a prosperous future.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTJEWELRY_DESC: Sparkling luxuries have arrived in the village! These fine jewellery pieces will surely bring a touch of elegance to those looking for extravagance.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTKNIGHT_DESC: A brave combatant takes up the mantle of knighthood, and the village rejoices! Sworn to serve their homeland, this proud Knight will bring honour, protection, and a sense of security to all.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTPILGRIM_DESC: Your Monastery warmly welcomes its very first pilgrim! These weary visitors are to be reminders that the reward of hardship is spiritual fulfilment.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTPRIOR_DESC: Reverence fills the air as your Monastery appoints its first Prior. This wise leader will guide the community in faith and wisdom, bringing all a more profound sense of peace and spiritual fulfilment.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTPRIORESS_DESC: Reverence fills the air as your Monastery appoints its first Prioress. This wise leader will guide the community in faith and wisdom, bringing all a more profound sense of peace and spiritual fulfilment.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTTOOL_DESC: An industrious clang of metal echoes through the village—tools are now crafted, not bought. Your villagers are eager to build, create, and thrive with these sturdy instruments!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTWEAPON_DESC: Sparks fly, and steel hardens as the village's first weapon is formed, bolstering your combatants, who realise they will soon wield these symbols of strength!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTWINE_DESC: A rich, fruity aroma fills the Monastery as the first bottle of wine is sealed. This new delight promises a taste of luxury and the prospect of great wealth ahead.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_HIREDBAILIFF_DESC: A sense of duty sweeps through the village as your Bailiff steps into office. As your trusted right hand, they are sworn to enforce your laws and uphold your will across the land!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_HIREDCOURTIER_DESC: The nomination of a Royal Courtier is a cause for celebration as it marks your entry into the royal court! Your villagers, full of envy, dream of enjoying similar luxury one day.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_HIREDEMISSARY_DESC: A calm resolve settles over your monastics with the appointment of a Monastic Emissary. As your trusted envoy, this wise figure will strengthen ties between the villages of the Faith.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_WONDERABBATIALCHURCH_DESC: A stunning Abbatial Church now adorns the Monastery's landscape, serving as a beacon of spiritual beauty! This grand structure offers a tranquil space for worship and reflection, lifting the community's spirit.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_WONDERBELFRY_DESC: A splendid City Belfry now graces the village horizon, its bells chiming proudly! This impressive structure embellishes the village's grandeur and marks a new chapter in its history.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_DRINKSURPLUS_DESC: Taverns are alive with excitement thanks to their fresh stock of drinks! With so many bottles in stock, every visit promises lively gatherings and cheerful toasts.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_GOODSSURPLUS_DESC: Shortages are now a distant memory! Thanks to the impressive surplus your people have crafted, the village is well-prepared for whatever challenges may come its way.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_HAPPYPILGRIM_DESC: Though weary, the last pilgrims to visit your Monastery were in remarkably high spirits! This is a true testament to your Monastics' warm hospitality, which continues to inspire followers of the Faith.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_HAPPYROYALCOMPANY_DESC: Thanks to the rigorous discipline at your Castle, another Royal Company leaves well-prepared for war! Such accomplishments are sure to elevate your influence at the royal court.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_HIGHCLERGYINFLUENCE_DESC: Your influence with the Clergy has struck a chord! Traders from the Estate are keen to win your favour by temporarily offering more generous and advantageous terms.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_HIGHKINGDOMINFLUENCE_DESC: The royal court has taken notice of your influence! For a while, they have decided you should enjoy increased benefits from trading along Kingdom-related routes.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_HIGHLABORINFLUENCE_DESC: The Elders value your fair influence! They've invited traders from the Labour Estate to allocate more resources, sweetening trade opportunities with you temporarily.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_LUXURYSURPLUS_DESC: The village revels in luxury goods, adding elegance to daily life! This abundance brings indulgence and sophistication to the community's esteemed members.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_WEAPONSURPLUS_DESC: Transporters agree: your stock of weapons has never been so high! This surplus could be worth a fortune to war-faring neighbours—unless you plan to equip a few new military companies yourself.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_DESC: The Bishop noticed that you can feed your people well! He now wants you to provide for the Clergy, just like they once provided for you. His steward promises you wealth and influence in return for herbs, berries and bread.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_HAGGLE_LOSE_DES: The steward is not interested in renegotiating the deal at the moment. What the Bishop offered is what you will get.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_HAGGLE_WIN_DESC: The steward ponders your words and agrees to increase the sum due for your bread, herbs and berries.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_RECURRING_DESC: The Bishop would like to purchase food from your illustrious land to help others under the benediction of the Clergy. His steward offers more gold and influence to help your monastery prosper in return for herbs, berries and bread.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_CHOICE_A: We will help our brothers and sisters.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_CHOICE_B: Our bread is worth more than that...
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_CHOICE_NO: We can't spare anything at the moment.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_SUCCESS_DESC: Your goods were redistributed to monasteries in need, which pleased the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_FAILURE_TITLE: Bread, Herbs and Berries Not Delivered
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_FAILURE_DESC: Your goods could not be distributed in time, which displeased the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_DESC: Misfortune struck the Bishop's steward on his way to your land, resulting in a lost shipment of bread meant for your people. He offers to show you where he lost the goods, even though he is exhausted. You might be able to salvage some if you act quickly.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_A: Forget the bread. Stay safe with us.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_B: Lead us to the wreck. You can rest later.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_NO: Nothing can be done about it. Leave us.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_A_SUCCESS: The Bishop's steward recovered from his ordeal and returned to his liege.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_A_FAILURE: The Bishop's steward returned to his liege while still weary from his journey.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_B_SUCCESS: Your transporters managed to recover the goods the Bishop's steward lost.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_B_FAILURE: Your transporters could not recover the goods the Bishop's steward lost.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_DESC: The Clergy was to send you more bread, but your ill influence brings hesitancy. While your liege, the Bishop, is more than willing to help you, he believes such favour is meant for those more deserving...
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_CHOICE_A: We will send the Clergy twice what they expect.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_CHOICE_B: A chestful of coins is certainly going to prove ourselves!
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_CHOICE_NO: We will take our chances without their help.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_SUCCESS_DESC: You have proven yourself to the Bishop and were granted influence among the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_FAILURE_DESC: You could not deliver the goods in time, which displeased the Bishop.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_TITLE: Offering Bread for your Herbs and Berries
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_DESC: With all his grace and mercy, the Bishop wants to ensure all regional monasteries are well-fed. He delegated a steward to ship you bread in exchange for herbs and berries harvested from your monastic lands.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_HAGGLE_LOSE_DES: The steward refuses to increase his already fair shipment of bread, yet he maintains his liege's deal, should you be interested.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_HAGGLE_WIN_DESC: The steward agrees to increase his bread shipment in exchange for the same amount of berries and herbs.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_RECURRING_DESC: The Bishop's steward returns with warming news: a fresh shipment of bread has been made ready for your monastery! As before, the Clergy demands herbs and berries in exchange.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_CHOICE_B: This is not nearly enough bread...
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_CHOICE_NO: We can't afford the deal right now.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_SUCCESS_DESC: Your goods were exchanged to the Bishop for a shipment of bread.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_FAILURE_DESC: Your goods could not be delivered to the Bishop in time, forfeiting the promised bread.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_QUEST_TITLE: Delivering Bread, Herbs and Berries to the Clergy
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver bread, herbs and berries to the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_QUEST_DESC: I have decided to host the Bishop's steward while he recovers.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_QUEST_TITLE: Delivering Herbs and Berries to the Bishop
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_QUEST_DESC: I have decided to send the Bishop a large shipment of herbs and berries.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_QUEST_OBJECTIVE: Host the Bishop's steward with 50% approval.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_QUEST_TITLE: Delivering Herbs and Berries to the Clergy
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver herbs and berries to the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: The bread will be forever lost, but taking care of the steward will certainly please the Bishop.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_B_TOOLTIP: Even though he is exhausted, the steward will lead your people to the wreckage so you have a chance to salvage the bread.
Most of the bread is saved.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_INCIDENT_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTI: The steward will return safely to the Bishop.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_CHOICE_A_TOOLTI: The Bishop will pay a fair share of coins for bread, herbs and berries from your land.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_CHOICE_B_TOOLTI: The price of bread is typically not negotiable, but you can still attempt to haggle.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_GIVEBREAD_CHOICE_NO_TOOLT: Bread is valuable. The Bishop's steward will return later with the same offer.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_CHOICE_A_TOO: The Bishop promises to put in good words if he is impressed by our lands.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_CHOICE_B_TOO: The Clergy always appreciate fair donations.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_LOWINFLUENCE_CHOICE_NO_TO: The Bishop may extend the offer later on, should you need it.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_CHOICE_A_TOOLTI: The Bishop will send you a shipment of bread as soon as you send him herbs and berries.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_CHOICE_B_TOOLTI: The Bishop is not interested in negotiations, but you can still try to haggle for more bread.
EVENTS.MONASTERYBREAD_NEEDBREAD_CHOICE_NO_TOOLT: The Bishop's steward promises that the offer will remain open later, should you need it.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_DESC: The Bishop appreciates seeing a new settlement dedicate itself to the monastic faith. He wants to help you—his new vassal—and appointed his steward to ensure you have everything you need. What do you plan next?
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_A: I want to build a magnificent monastery.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_B: I want to be influential among the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_C: I want to earn wealth through trade.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_NO: Our Faith is all I need.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_DESC: The Bishop wishes for your monastery to prosper.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: The Bishop will send you construction materials so you can improve your land.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_B_TOOLTIP: The Bishop will share good words about your land, improving your influence.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_C_TOOLTIP: The Bishop will send you coins to purchase goods from trade routes.
EVENTS.MONASTERYWELCOME_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: The Bishop will withdraw his offer.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_EARLYDELIVERY_DESC: A group of wandering monks are seeking to resupply for the road ahead. While they don't have anything of value to trade for the goods, they promise to spread the word of your generosity.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_EARLYDELIVERY_RECURRING: The wandering monks returned and are still seeking supplies. They promise to spread the word about your generosity should you accept to donate goods for the road ahead.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_EARLYDELIVERY_CHOICE_A: Make sure these monks are well-supplied.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_EARLYDELIVERY_CHOICE_NO: There's nothing we can do to help.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_DESC: A fellowship of wandering monks would like to spend a month at your Hospitium. Although they don't have much to donate, they promise to spread the word about your land if treated well.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_RECURRIN: Wandering monks are once again seeking refuge at your illustrious monastery. For a month of peace, they promise to spread the word about your land among the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_CHOICE_A: Our monastery is open to all.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_CHOICE_B: While you rest, let me restock you for the road.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_CHOICE_N: We cannot afford more people right now.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_HOSTING_: The wandering monks appreciated their time at your monastery and promised to return.
The wandering monks did not appreciate their time at your monastery.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_DELIVERY: The wandering monks received supplies for the road ahead.
The wandering monks did not receive the supplies they were promised.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_DESC: Wandering monks are once again seeking shelter! They shared the road with a group of renowned craftspeople who hail from Myddle and are supposedly influential over the village's lordship. Hosting such people could open up opportunities with Myddle.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_CHOICE_A: This is a good opportunity to discuss trade.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_CHOICE_B: If they can afford to rent beds with gold, let them.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_CHOICE_C: We will treat them the same as everyone else.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_CHOICE_NO: We can't host anyone at the moment.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_QUEST_TITL: Hosting People from Myddle for a Month
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_QUEST_DESC: I have offered to host wandering monks and their travelling companions for a month.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_HOSTING_SU: The craftspeople from Myddle appreciated their time at your monastery.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_HOSTING_FA: The craftspeople from Myddle did not appreciate their time at your monastery.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_HOSTING_: Hosting Wandering Monks for a Month
I have offered to host wandering monks for a month.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_DELIVERY: Delivering supplies to the Wandering Monks
I have promised to supply the wandering monks for their travel.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_QUEST_OBJE: Host the folks from Myddle with 90% approval.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_EARLYDELIVERY_CHOICE_A_: For supplies, the wandering monks will help you gain influence among the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_EARLYDELIVERY_CHOICE_B_: Instead of supplies, the wandering monks will be handed a few coins. They promise to mention your generosity to the Clergy.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_EARLYDELIVERY_CHOICE_NO: The wandering monks will continue to travel. They will return to you later on.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_CHOICE_A_T: Hosting these renowned craftsmen is your chance to open a trade route with Myddle.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_CHOICE_B_T: These wealthy craftsmen have ample coin and don't seem to mind paying for their stay so long as it is pleasant.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_CHOICE_C_T: Being renowned and wealthy does not make you any better—these craftsmen should have the same rights as everyone else.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_MYDDLEPEOPLE_CHOICE_NO_: The craftsmen will find somewhere else to stay, but they promise they will eventually return.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_CHOICE_A: The wandering monks will stay for a month and promise good words to the Clergy if they are treated right.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_CHOICE_B: The wandering monks will stay for a month and expect you to supply them for the road.
EVENTS.MONASTERYHOSTING_WANDERINGMONKS_CHOICE_N: The wandering monks will find somewhere else to stay but promise to be back later.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DESC: The Abbess of Kinstone Abbey would like monasteries on both sides to collaborate.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_DESC: The Abbess is glad you have established a trade route with Kinstone Abbey. She believes monasteries on both sides would benefit from trading with each other and would like to know if you need anything.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_CHOICE_A: A donation of coins would be much appreciated.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_CHOICE_B: I could use better trade prices.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_CHOICE_NO: We will be fine without help.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_CHOICE_DESC: The Abbess is looking forward to doing further business with you.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_DESC: The Abbess appreciates your ever-growing commerce and would like to bolster these partnerships by arranging more deals between the Clergy and neighbouring villages. Where these deals are to be conducted is up to you.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_CHOICE_A: Let's invite them over to our monastery.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_CHOICE_B: Our best herbalist will take care of it...
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_CHOICE_C: Negotiations will be held on the Abbess's land...
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_CHOICE_NO: Alas, it will have to be done later.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_FAILURE_DESC: The merchants did not appreciate their time at your monastery and declined further deals.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_SUCCESS_DESC: The merchants were swayed in your favour and agreed to future deals.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_DESC: Dealings with Kinstone Abbey did not go well, and the Abbess decided to intervene to prevent a greater diplomatic incident. She proposes you make amends and turn this event in your favour.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_CHOICE_A: We will show them how resourceful we are.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_CHOICE_B: A large sum of coins will surely do!
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_CHOICE_C: I'd rather have the Bishop sort this out!
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_CHOICE_NO: Let it go. Time solves everything.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_FAILURE_DESC: You could not appease tensions with Kinstone Abbey and lost your trading rights for a while.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_SUCCESS_DESC: You resolved tensions with Kinstone Abbey and improved your common trade!
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_DESC: The Abbess is interested in setting up new trade route deals but cannot do so from her monastery. Deeming your land suitable for accommodations, she would be much obliged if you were to help her delegate work out deals on her behalf.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_CHOICE_A: It will be my pleasure to host them.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_CHOICE_NO: We don't have time for it right now.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_DESC: The Abbess's delegate plans to demonstrate the knowledge of monastic herbalists to improve trading negotiations. However, she lacks a herbalist for the plan to work.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_CHOICE_A: Let our best herbalist demonstrate their knowledge...
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_CHOICE_B: I'm sure the Bishop could lend us some manuscripts!
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_CHOICE_C: This is her idea. Let her figure it out.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_DESC: The Abbess's delegate hopes to discuss business with the merchants over a fine meal. She was wondering if you had any suggestions for where to host them.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_CHOICE_A: Our best Refectorian will take care of it...
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_CHOICE_B: Buy yourself the best our lands can offer. It's on me!
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_CHOICE_C: At a market? You aren't so sure yourself.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_DESC: The Abbess's delegate wants to impress the merchants by showing them the wealth everyone would earn from these deals. She isn't sure of the best way to make her point.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_CHOICE_A: Our best Emissary will show them our profitable ledgers...
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_CHOICE_B: Let the monuments to our Faith speak for themselves...
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_CHOICE_C: You're the delegate. You know better than I do.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_FAILURE_DE: The Abbess's delegate failed to impress the merchants using our herbalistic expertise.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_FAILURE_DE: The Abbess's delegate failed to impress the merchants over dinner.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_FAILURE_DE: The Abbess's delegate failed to sway the merchants with the idea of the wealth they could earn.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_SUCCESS_DE: The Abbess's delegate successfully impressed the merchants using our herbalistic expertise.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_SUCCESS_DE: The Abbess's delegate successfully impressed the merchants over dinner.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_SUCCESS_DE: The Abbess's delegate successfully impressed the merchants with the idea of the wealth they could earn.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_FAILURE_DESC: The Abbess's delegate failed to conduct her deals properly.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_SUCCESS_DESC: The Abbess's delegate negotiated her deals successfully!
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to host merchants from neighbouring villages to discuss trading deals with them.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_QUEST_DESC: I have pledged to increase my trading volume with Kinstone Abbey.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_QUEST_DESC: I have promised to help the Abbess negotiate new trade route deals.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_CHOICE_A_TOOLT: The Abbess suggests you increase the volume of trade goods with Kinstone Abbey.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_CHOICE_B_TOOLT: The Abbess suggests that coins will most certainly improve trade relations.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_CHOICE_C_TOOLT: The Bishop can be persuaded to make amends for your mistake.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_DIPLOMATIC_CHOICE_NO_TOOL: The Abbess will eventually overlook this incident.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: Delegates of the Abbess and the neighbouring villagers will gather on your land to discuss trading partnerships.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: The Abbess will seek alternative methods to handle her trading partnerships.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_CHOICE_A_T: One of your people will help the Abbess's delegate.
The trade routes' delegates are amazed.
The trade routes' delegates are bored.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_CHOICE_B_T: By reaching the Bishop, you will ensure the Abbess's delegate has everything she needs.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_1_CHOICE_C_T: The Abbess's delegate will work out a way to demonstrate monastic herbalism.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_CHOICE_A_T: One of your people will host the delegate's meal.
The trade routes' delegates are delighted.
The trade routes' delegates are disgusted.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_CHOICE_B_T: The Abbess's delegate has a fair budget to organise the event.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_2_CHOICE_C_T: The Abbess's delegate will organise the event by herself.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_CHOICE_A_T: One of your people will demonstrate how wealthy monasteries are.
The trade routes' delegates are intrigued.
The trade routes' delegates are perplexed.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_CHOICE_B_T: The Abbess's delegate will demonstrate the Clergy's wealth through the splendour of your village.
The trade routes' delegates are wonderstruck.
The trade routes' delegates are daunted.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_FAVOUR_EVENT_3_CHOICE_C_T: The Abbess's delegate will decide for herself how to prove her point.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: The Abbess will gift you a chest of coins.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_CHOICE_B_TOOLTIP: The Abbess will discuss deals with followers of the Faith.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_CHOICE_C_TOOLTIP: The Abbess will gift you a shipment of construction materials.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_START_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: The Abbess will withdraw her offer.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: Delegates of neighbouring villages will travel to your land to discuss trade.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_CHOICE_B_TOOLTIP: Some of your herbalists will travel to neighbouring villages and showcase your goods.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_CHOICE_C_TOOLTIP: Your influence among the Clergy will affect how much resources are invested in your favour.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_WEALTHY_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: The Abbess will waive the offer but might bring it back later.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_DESC: Kinstone Abbey faced trade challenges last season! The Abbess aims to improve relations with your monastery and has negotiated better terms with local merchants. They are now ready to offer reduced prices on certain goods at specific times in exchange for increased trade volume.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_CHOICE_A: Barrels are hard to come by.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_CHOICE_A_TO: Kinstone Abbey pledges to slightly reduce barrel prices in exchange for increased trade.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_CHOICE_B_TO: Kinstone Abbey pledges to reduce the price of polished stone in exchange for increased trade.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_CHOICE_C: Cheese is a useful good to stock.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_CHOICE_C_TO: Kinstone Abbey pledges to greatly reduce cheese prices in exchange for increased trade.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_CHOICE_NO: You won't alter your trading for these goods.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_CHOICE_NO_T: The Abbess will withdraw the offer for now but might put it on the table again later.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_DESC: Thanks to your steady trade, last season has been good for Kinstone Abbey! The appreciative Abbess planned on donating the surplus to needy villages and hoped you would join the effort.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_CHOICE_A: We can sell you the goods.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_CHOICE_A_TOO: Kinstone Abbey will pay a fair price for the herbs and berries you deliver.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_CHOICE_B_TOO: Kinstone Abbey will receive a donation of herbs and berries.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_CHOICE_NO: We can't help the Abbess right now.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_CHOICE_NO_TO: Kinstone Abbey will find help elsewhere.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_CHOICE_DESC: Merchants from Kinstone Abbey are thankful for your business and fulfilled their end of the deal, as promised!
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_CHOICE_A_DES: You sold and delivered supplies to Kinstone Abbey, for which they are thankful.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_CHOICE_B_DES: You successfully sent free supplies to Kinstone Abbey, for which they are most grateful.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_FAILURE_DESC: You could not deliver supplies to Kinstone Abbey in time.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_QUEST_TITLE: Increase Trading Volume with Kinstone Abbey
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADEINCREASE_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to increase our trading volume with Kinstone Abbey.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_DONATED_QUES: I have promised to donate supplies to Kinstone Abbey.
EVENTS.MONASTERYTRADE_TRADESURPLUS_SOLD_QUEST_D: I have promised to sell supplies to Kinstone Abbey.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_DESC: The Elders would like you to host a fair! This is an occasion to open up more trading opportunities by celebrating the fruit of hard labour. Ensure the mood at the fair stays high—your people will do the rest.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_BERRYFAIR_DESC: With so many berries in storage, the Elders would like you to host a trading fair dedicated to the tasty little red fruits! If you can ensure everyone has a good time, there is a good chance the trading value of this resource will improve.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_BERRYFAIR_CHOICE_B: Order my foragers to work double...
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_BERRYFAIR_CHOICE_B_TOOLTIP: The fair will begin, and while visitors head to the village, your foragers will try to work faster.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_BREADFAIR_DESC: With so much bread in the granaries, the Elders believe your village might be ready for a bread fair! If you can ensure everyone has a good time, there is a good chance the trading value of this resource will improve.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_BREADFAIR_CHOICE_B: Order my bakers to work double...
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_BREADFAIR_CHOICE_B_TOOLTIP: The fair will begin, and while visitors head to the village, your bakers will try to work faster.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_FISHFAIR_DESC: With so many fish in storage, the Elders believe your village is due for a fish fair! If you can ensure everyone has a splashingly good time, there is a good chance the trading value of this resource will improve.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_FISHFAIR_CHOICE_B: Order my fishermen to work double...
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_FISHFAIR_CHOICE_B_TOOLTIP: The fair will begin, and while visitors head to the village, your fishermen will try to work faster.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_FAIR_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: Your villagers will ask to host a trading fair later.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_LOWHAPPINESS_DESC: The Elders would like you to host a trade fair with neighbouring villages, but your villagers can hardly smile these days! Lowering taxes and ensuring your people have everything they need would surely help.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_HAPPINESS_CHOICE_A: Let's put a smile on those faces!
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_HAPPINESS_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: People will expect the mood around the village to improve.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_HAPPINESS_CHOICE_NO: Life is hard. Get used to it!
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_HAPPINESS_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: Your villagers will not expect more of this, but they may ask again later.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_LOWSPLENDOR_DESC: The Elders feel your village is almost ready to host a trading fair. However, they are uneasy about receiving visitors with such a market! They would like you to improve its appearance. A few colourful tents wouldn't hurt business, would it?
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_SPLENDOR_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: Villagers will expect the market to look better.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_SPLENDOR_CHOICE_NO: There's nothing wrong with discoloured tents.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_SPLENDOR_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: Villagers will not expect the market to change, although they might ask again later.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_REGIONFAIR_DESC: The Elders would like you to host a regional fair! This is an occasion to open up more trading opportunities by celebrating the fruit of hard labour. Ensure the mood at the fair stays high—your people will do the rest.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_REGIONFAIR_CHOICE_A: I will make sure everyone appreciates their time.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_REGIONFAIR_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: The fair will begin, and visitors will head to the village.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_FAIR_FAILURE_DESC: The fair did not go as well as people hoped! While trading will not improve anytime soon, your people still appreciate the effort. They want to give the fair another try later, should you desire so.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_FAIR_SUCCESS_DESC: The fair lived up to expectations! People from all around are spreading praise about your fine craftsmanship and hope to do further business with your village!
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_HAPPINESS_FAILURE_DESC: Even though you promised your villagers that you would cheer them up, not much has actually changed.
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_HAPPINESS_SUCCESS_DESC: You promised to cheer up your people and successfully fulfilled your promise!
EVENTS.LABOURFAIR_SPLENDOR_SUCCESS_DESC: People rejoice! Your market looks ready for a trading fair!

The King has noticed your Castle and wants to be sure that you, his loyal vassal, have everything you need to host an army.

EVENTS.LABOURBREWER_GIVEHOPS_CLOTHING_DESC: Relatives of your villagers have learned about your hops surplus and would like to trade you some everyday clothes in exchange, as you seem to be running low on them.

EVENTS.LABOURBREWER_GIVEHOPS_CHOICE_NO: Sorry, but I need the hops.

EVENTS.LABOURBREWER_NEEDBEER_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: The villagers will return later with another beer offer.
EVENTS.LABOURBREWER_NEEDHOPS_BERRY_DESC: A party of travellers heard your breweries are low on hops. It just so happens that they know of a monastery not too far away that could trade you some of their surplus in exchange for berries.
EVENTS.LABOURBREWER_NEEDHOPS_WHEAT_DESC: A party of travellers heard your breweries are low on hops. It just so happens that they know of a monastery not too far away that could trade you some of their surplus in exchange for wheat.

EVENTS.LABOURBREWER_NEEDHOPS_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: As soon as the berries are delivered, you will receive a shipment of hops.

EVENTS.LABOURBREWER_INCIDENT_SPOIL_CHOICE_NO_TO: You keep and distribute the beer. No one has to know.

EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_ASPIRATIONS_COMPLETIO: You have decided what your village should strive for! If you change your mind, you can revise your Village Aspirations anytime.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_PREPARECOMPANY_DESC: While your combatants are most grateful for the Keep, they believe they lack the preparation for actual warfare. They would appreciate it if you could provide them with decent weapons and let them help village folks.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_PREPARECOMPANY_COMPLE: Your company will be facing action soon! Ensure they are adequately equipped, healed, and trained when they return.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_PREPARECOMPANY_QUEST_: I have promised to provide for my combatants' needs.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGCASTLE_DESC: Your villagers dream of a castle! It would make the roads safer, and companies could be relied upon for dangerous chores. They say a splendid castle could even catch the King's eye!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGCASTLE_COMPLE: Your castle is complete! Your first Company will be gathering at the Keep. Encampments are necessary to form additional Companies.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGCASTLE_QUEST_: I have agreed to build a castle in our village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CRAFTINGSPEARS_DESC: Your combatants bear terrible news: there are no spears! They won't be able to do much without them, and training barehanded is insufficient. They suggest you start producing more - urgently!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CRAFTINGSPEARS_BOW_DE: Your combatants bear terrible news: there are no bows! They won't be able to do much without them, and training barehanded is insufficient. They suggest you start producing more - urgently!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CRAFTINGSPEARS_SWORD_: Your combatants bear terrible news: there are no swords! They won't be able to do much without them, and training barehanded is insufficient. They suggest you start producing more - urgently!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CRAFTINGSPEARS_COMPLE: With a new supply of weapons, your combatants will soon be ready to return to the battlefield. Be sure to keep your stock steady!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CRAFTINGSPEARS_QUEST_: I have promised to produce more weapons for my combatants.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CRAFTINGRATIONS_DESC: Your companies' great reputation has brought you new and exciting missions, though some are weeks of travel away. Since combatants won't fight on empty stomachs, you should start packing War Rations!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CRAFTINGRATIONS_COMPL: Famished no more, the combatants can hit the road! They suggest you keep the cooks cooking: Having more War Rations is always better than running out.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CRAFTINGRATIONS_QUEST: I have promised to produce War Rations for my combatants.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_MONASTERYTRADEHERBS_D: Your Monastics harvested their first herbs! It's essential to sell these precious resources through trade routes to ensure the profitability of your Monastery. As your Monastery expands, you'll access even more valuable resources to trade.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_MONASTERYTRADEHERBS_C: Let us provide for the needs of others.
Open up a trade route and sell herbs to a neighbouring village.
You have gained quite a bit from the trade! To increase your profit, produce more resources while improving Trade Routes.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_MONASTERYTRADEHERBS_Q: I have agreed to sell herbs via Trade Routes.

EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_CASTLE HARBOR_1_DESC: The knights of Castle Harbor are looking for patrons to support a small diplomatic expedition. They expect this journey to greatly improve future trade relations.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_CASTLE HARBOR_2_DESC: The last expedition earned the knights new valuable allies who informed them of further realms of great wealth. Castle Harbour would like you to support such a promising expedition.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_CASTLE HARBOR_3_DESC: Thanks to your patronage, the influence of Castle Harbor extends far beyond our realm. Their knights see diplomatic opportunities in lands further away and hope for your assistance.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_CASTLE HARBOR_R_DESC: The knights of Castle Harbour appreciate trading with us! They have heard of distant realms they would like to partner with and would appreciate it if we could support them.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_CASTLE HARBOR_QUEST: War Ration delivery to Castle Harbor
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_1_DESC:
The Abbess heard you were interested in dedicating your land to the Clergy. She sees great potential and wants you to start immediately by founding a small monastery. 

She first suggests supporting your monastics by opening trade routes with your neighbours.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_1_CHOICE_A: I pledge my land to the Faith.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_1_CHOICE_A_TOO: The Abbess will expect you to build a monastery on your land.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_CHOICE_NO: We are not ready for this right now.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: The Abbess will ask you again later.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_2_DESC:
The Abbess is pleased with the progress of your monastery and believes you should now aim to establish a Priory.

This would mean significantly increasing your population and establishing a Trade Route with Kinstone Abbey.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_2_CHOICE_A_TOO: The Abbess will expect you to expand your monastery.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_3_DESC:
The Abbess is delighted with the development of your Monastery. She envisions the potential for significant expansion by improving its luxury trade.

A realm of prosperity and grandeur like this would serve the Faith in many ways.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_3_CHOICE_A_TOO: The Abbess will expect you to improve your monastery and its trade.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_DESC:
The Abbess takes great pride in your accomplishments; your Priory stands as one of the crown jewels of our Faith! A monastery of such an esteemed reputation should seek to boast a thriving population, foster fair trading partnerships, and have a grand Abbatial Church.

Upon achieving these goals, the Abbess herself promises to bless your land.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_CHOICE_A: Our Priory will be known to all.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_CHOICE_A_TOO: The Abbess will expect you to expand your monastery and build an Abbatial Church.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_5_DESC: Your esteemed monastery, a pinnacle of its kind, has fulfilled the Abbess's aspirations. Eager to witness its success, she wishes to conclude your journey by staying in your revered land for a few months.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_5_CHOICE_A_TOO: The Abbess will expect to stay at your monastery for a few months.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_REWARD_DESC: In gratitude for your dedicated service to the Faith, the Abbess and Bishop wish to bestow upon you a generous donation of coins—vast riches meant to foster prosperity for the faithful within your monastery and beyond.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_REWARD_CHOICE_A: This blessing will serve a just cause!
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_REWARD_CHOICE_TOOLT: The Clergy will grant you riches.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_REWARD_COMPLETION_D: Your monastery earned the highest favour with the Clergy.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_1_SUCCESS_DESC: You dedicated your land to the Faith by building a monastery.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_2_SUCCESS_DESC: You developed your monastery into a renowned Priory.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_3_SUCCESS_DESC: You developed your Priory into a splendid economic hub.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_SUCCESS_DESC: You developed your Priory into a realm of wealth.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_5_FAILURE_DESC: The Abbess hopes her next visit will be more pleasant.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_5_SUCCESS_DESC: The Abbess had a pleasant stay and recognized the success of your Priory.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_1_QUEST_DESC: I have promised the Abbess we would build a monastery on our land.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_2_QUEST_DESC: I have promised the Abbess we would turn our monastery into a successful Priory.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_3_QUEST_DESC: I have promised the Abbess we would improve the wealth of our Priory.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_QUEST_DESC: I have promised the Abbess we would make our Priory renowned across the realm.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_5_QUEST_DESC: I have invited the Abbess to stay in our Priory for a few months.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_5_QUEST_OBJECT: Host the Abbess and her suite with 95% approval.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_5_QUEST_GROUPK: The Abbess and her suite are approaching your village.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_1_A_DE: The Abbess envisions her stay as an opportunity to host a regional Mass. She anticipates a well-organised event that will draw pilgrims from across the region and trusts in your capability to host it gracefully.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_1_A_CH: The Abbess will call for a large Mass, attracting pilgrims from around the region.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_1_B_DE: The Abbess sees her stay as a chance to host an Abbey Council. Expecting a meticulously organised event attracting priors and prioresses region-wide, she trusts in your ability to host this significant gathering gracefully.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_1_B_CH: The Abbess will call for an Abbey Council, attracting priors and prioresses from around the region.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_1_C_DE: The Abbess envisions her stay as an opportunity to host a trade gathering. Anticipating a meticulously organised event that attracts traders from across the region, she trusts in your ability to host this significant gathering gracefully.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_1_C_CH: The Abbess will call for a trade gathering, attracting wealthy traders from around the region.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_1_CHOI: Another monastery would be more suitable.
Your best Emissary will make sure another monastery hosts.
The Bishop would be an ideal host.
You will use your influence to let the Bishop handle the event.
Refusing to host the event might disappoint the Abbess.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_2_A_DE: Upon receiving a letter detailing the misfortune of a vital merchant for her monastery, the Abbess demands your intervention. Recognising your resourcefulness, she urges you to take swift action to safeguard her trader.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_2_A_CH: A donation of coins should be suitable.
The Abbess will expect you to donate coins within the next few days.
We will provide them with new merchandise.
The Abbess will expect you to donate goods within the next few days.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_2_B_DE: Upon receiving a letter detailing the fire in one of her monasteries' libraries, the Abbess demands your intervention. Recognising your resourcefulness, she urges you to take swift action to safeguard its knowledge.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_2_B_CH: The Abbess will expect you to donate manuscripts within the next few days.
We have spare material for them.
The Abbess will expect you to donate construction materials within the next few days.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_2_C_DE: Upon receiving a letter detailing a devastating storm in her hometown, the Abbess demands your intervention. Recognising your resourcefulness, she urges you to take swift action to prevent the village's end.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_2_C_CH: The Abbess will expect you to donate berries within the next few days.
Our herbs will help them recover.
The Abbess will expect you to donate herbs within the next few days.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_2_CHOI: I am sure the Bishop can help out.
You will use your influence to have the Bishop help out in your stead.
Refusing to help the Abbess might disappoint her.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_3_A_DE:
As her stay nears its end, the Abbess decides on a final trial, asserting that a Priory's true worth lies in its wine. Beyond stone and scriptures, only the blessed aroma of grapes is eternal.

She then asks: Is your Priory worthy of the Faith?
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_3_A_CH: Let my Vintners demonstrate their craftsmanship.
Your Best Vintner will attempt to amaze the Abbess.
My wine will speak for itself!
You will gift the Abbess a sizeable casket of wine.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_3_B_DE:
As her stay nears its end, the Abbess decides on a final trial, asserting that a Priory's true worth lies in its stone. Beyond wealth and knowledge, only the hardship of the sacred stone is eternal.

She then asks: Is your Priory worthy of the Faith?
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_3_B_CH: My monastery will speak for itself!
You will try to impress the Abbess with the Splendour of your Monastery.
Let my Builders tell you about their work.
Your best Builder will attempt to impress the Abbess.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_EVENT_3_C_DE:
As her stay nears its end, the Abbess decides on a final trial, asserting that a Priory's true worth lies in its knowledge. Beyond beauty and luxury, only the sanctity of erudition is eternal.

She then asks: Is your Priory worthy of the Faith?

You will gift the Abbess a fair collection of manuscripts.

EVENTS.KINGDOMHOSTING_WELCOME_DESC:
The King took notice of your castle! Standing tall and proud by the realm's outskirts, he intends to use it to attend his weary royal companies.

The King wants you to send a Royal Courtier to his court so they can discuss this matter further.
EVENTS.KINGDOMHOSTING_WELCOME_CHOICE_A: I will send an envoy at once!
EVENTS.KINGDOMHOSTING_WELCOME_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: The King expects you to mandate a Royal Courtier to visit his court.
EVENTS.KINGDOMHOSTING_HOSTING_FAILURE_DESC: The King's company marched away, demoralized and unfit for battle.
EVENTS.KINGDOMHOSTING_HOSTING_SUCCESS_DESC: To the satisfaction of the First Constable, the King's company left your village prepped and ready for battle.
